facialDescription: oval face, high cheekbones, expressive dark brown eyes, full lips with natural pigment, subtle laugh lines, strong brow
hairDescription: long wavy dark brown hair with subtle caramel highlights, usually worn loose or in a high ponytail
skinTone: warm medium-dark brown, morena clara, golden undertones
wardrobeCore: modern LatAm street style — fitted jeans, graphic crop tops, leather jacket, white sneakers; professional look: blazer over simple blouse
accessories: gold hoop earrings, thin gold necklace with small cross pendant, occasional silver rings
backstory: Valentina grew up in a working-class neighborhood in CDMX. The daughter of a seamstress and a mechanic, she became the first in her family to attend university, studying marketing. She now runs a small social media agency serving local small businesses.
dialectAccent: Mexican Spanish, CDMX accent, occasional chilango slang (güey, wey, padre)

referenceAssets.description: Face reference: straight-on, natural light, no makeup
Wardrobe reference: street style, leather jacket
